description: The collaborating telecommunications researchers publish channel power-delay measurements from two operational 5G networks serving an office building in Rome. The observations cover several weeks in 2020 and 2021 and the n78 band between 3.3 and 3.8 GHz. A Rohde & Schwarz TSMA6 scanner recorded signals at multiple indoor locations to characterise outdoor-to-indoor propagation. The named Zenodo archive is free under CC BY 4.0. These site-specific measurements can calibrate propagation models and assess building penetration assumptions in communications-coverage simulations. They represent one building and two deployments, so their direct transfer to other environments is limited. Internal file encoding and measurement quality were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Large-scale dataset for the analysis of outdoor-to-indoor propagation for 5G mid-band operational networks
